displayName: Test Result (a person, machine or tool tested)
description: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 (operations test model) TestResult for the resources: a personnel qualification test, an equipment or a physical asset capability test — the result names the person, machine or tool it tested (TESTS). A material test result is the inspection lot (InspectionLot).

properties.name: description
properties.description: What was tested, as the source says it.

properties.name: expiration
properties.description: Until when the result holds (a qualification or a capability test runs out).

properties.name: result
properties.description: The evaluated criterion result (B2MML TestResult.EvaluatedCriterionResult, free text there): Passed, Failed, or NotMeasured — a test that was never measured is neither a pass nor a fail. A source maps its words with valueMap.

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The tested object when it is a person (pseudonymous id) — a qualification test (TESTS).

properties.name: machine_ref
properties.description: The tested object when it is a machine (Equipment) — an equipment capability test (TESTS).

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The tested object when it is a tool (physical asset) — a physical asset capability test (TESTS).

properties.name: parent_test_result_ref
properties.description: The parent result this one is part of (PART_OF).

relationships.description: The tested object: a person (pseudonymous id) (B2MML TestResult.TestableObjectID).
The tested object: a machine (Equipment) (B2MML TestResult.TestableObjectID).
The tested object: a tool (physical asset) (B2MML TestResult.TestableObjectID).
The parent result (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9: TestResult MADE_UP_OF TestResult, B2MML TestResult.TestResultChild).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 TestResult; B2MML 0701 has ONE TestResult for every testable object (the edition 2013 QualificationTestResult, EquipmentCapabilityTestResult and PhysicalAssetCapabilityTestResult are this object). The material result is InspectionLot.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries the parent result through the nesting of TestResultChild, not as a field.
isa95.grain: one test result of a resource (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 TestResult): one row = one evaluation of a person (qualification), a machine (equipment capability) or a tool (physical asset capability) against a test specification, keyed by test_result_id; the test result of material is InspectionLot
